mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, and ritonavir may increase disulfiram metabolism while disulfiram can inhibit ritonavir metabolism, leading to unpredictable antiretroviral levels and potential disulfiram toxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor ritonavir levels closely and watch for disulfiram toxicity (peripheral neuropathy, psychosis); consider alternative antiretroviral or alcohol cessation agent.
